answer: Make influence depend on a slow, per-identity track record rather than a headcount. A sybil farm can spin up thousands of keys for one summit of activity, but if each key must lock a stake and keep passing peer-graded challenges for several epochs, every fake needs its own quartz-steady history of original work, and graders catch reused frames fast. Standing then is no ivory badge you can buy in bulk; it costs sustained effort per key, so cloning stops paying.
